summary: Tank uses a monitor to track Neo's movement, identifying a specific fire escape at the end of an alley as the next point of interest for Neo to reach.

what_changes.after: Identifies the specific target location (fire escape) for Neo
what_changes.evidence: Finger on the monitor, Tank traces Neo's path. That's it! You're almost there! That fire escape at the end of the alley!

event_hint.one_line: Tank directs Neo toward the fire escape exit.
